title: “Freedom=Hesed” A Yom HaShoah Message by Rabbi David Tawil

chapters.title: Introduction to Yom HaShoah and Pesach
chapters.about: Commemorating Yom HaShoah in the wake of Pesach and defining slavery.

chapters.title: The Mentality of a Slave
chapters.about: Primo Levi's account of the concentration camps and sharing bread.

chapters.title: True Freedom and Chesed
chapters.about: Rabbi Jonathan Sacks on the opening statement of the Haggadah and the ability to help others.

chapters.title: Memorializing the Holy Ones
chapters.about: Exerting our freedom as benei chorin to do chesed in memory of Am Yisrael.

summary: Rabbi David Tawil shares a Yom HaShoah message connecting the themes of Pesach, slavery, and freedom. He explains, referencing Rabbi Jonathan Sacks and Primo Levi, that true freedom is the ability to care for and do chesed for others rather than just surviving.
questions: What is the connection between Pesach and Yom HaShoah?
How does Primo Levi define the mentality of a slave?
Why do we invite people in at the beginning of the Haggadah?
How can we properly memorialize those who died al kiddush Hashem?
